name: mcp-health
description: Shows a band above the prompt when a plugin's MCP server is not connected, naming the server and the next step. Hidden while every watched server is connected.

watch.title: Servers to watch
watch.description: MCP server names as /mcp lists them, such as plugin:oh-my-claudecode:t or claude.ai Linear. Added to the plugin servers found automatically; a name is checked only once this session has seen it start.

ignore.title: Servers to ignore
ignore.description: MCP server names as /mcp lists them that never raise the band.
